slug: 2026-07-09 Nigeria seeks support to operationalize new digital ID law as NIN tops 136M

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports President Tinubu enacted the NIMC Act 2026 in June 2026, replacing the 19-year-old NIMC Act 2007.

Biometric Update reports the NIMC Act 2026, described as the new digital identity law, recognises the NIN as the foundational identity under the 'one person, one identity' policy; no event date given, published 2026-07-09 used.
